title: PetSmart Pet Grooming Locations - Omaha, Nebraska

facts.fact: PetSmart's Omaha Oak View grooming salon is located at 3103 Oak View Dr, Omaha, NE 68144.
The phone number listed for the PetSmart Omaha Oak View grooming salon is 402-333-1048.
The PetSmart Omaha Oak View grooming salon lists Sunday hours of 8am to 6pm.
The PetSmart Omaha Oak View grooming salon lists Monday hours of 7am to 9pm.
The PetSmart Omaha Oak View grooming salon lists Saturday hours of 7am to 9pm.
PetSmart states that its academy-trained Pet Stylists bring over 800 hours of hands-on experience to appointments.
facts.quote: our academy-trained Pet Stylists bring over 800 hours of hands-on experience to the appointment

facts.fact: PetSmart's Omaha grooming salon lists quick services including nail trims, teeth brushing, and ear cleaning as walk-in options.
facts.quote: Quick & convenient services include nail trims, teeth brushing, ear cleaning & more.

facts.fact: The PetSmart Omaha grooming page lists 'Book now' as the booking option for grooming appointments.
